storage_recommendations.special_storage: Refrigerate in amber bottle at no more than 8°C

comments.ph: The pH of a 50% concentration of A32 in a 52.6% dioxane/water solution was calculated to be 2.92 at 22°C according to the extrapolation procedures by Dr. P. D. Schickedantz, Lorillard Research Center Accession No. 1662, Reference OR 83-125.
comments.oral: 5g A32 forms a suspension with stirring in 10 ml 1% Tween 80 at room temperature. Reference OR 72-151.
comments.acute_cardiovascular: Mix 2 mg A32 with 0.2 ml 80% propylene glycol and grind lightly. Add 0.8 ml saline solution. A32 is a suspension in this mixture at room temperature. Reference OR 72-152.
